pairs.why: The warm cream body looks like the beige computer and the saturated toy-like real cards, while A's cool grey reads as glossier metal, closer to the statue-like drawings the lessons rejected.
This is the same pair as q008 with the sides swapped: the cream console (A) has the warm, soft plastic look of the real cards, and the grey one (B) looks colder and more metallic.

B's orange stripes give it the bright colour accents the real vehicles have, and its ground is smoother, while A's purple ground is covered in pebbles and grit, the over-textured look the lessons marked down.

This is the same pair as q010 with the sides swapped: the striped rover on smoother ground (A) is closer to the colourful, clean real cards than the plain white rover on gritty, rock-strewn purple ground (B).
